name: jev-mod
description: A cheap decision model picks each turn's skill, model and effort, compacts on request, and withholds injected text

api_key.title: Decision backend key
api_key.description: Your key for the provider below (TypeSafe unless you pick another). Kept in Claude Code's credential store (the Keychain on macOS; ~/.claude/.credentials.json, a 0600 file, on Linux) and handed only to this mod, never to the conversation. Leave empty to use a key in the environment or one jev-skills stored; set it to none to stop using one set here.

provider.title: Provider for that key
provider.description: Who answers the decisions with the key above: TypeSafe, or Jev through OpenRouter, Venice or OpenCode Zen.

backend_api_key.title: Named backend key
backend_api_key.description: The key for the decision server named as default in ~/.config/jev/backends.json, if you use one. Kept in Claude Code's credential store (the Keychain on macOS; ~/.claude/.credentials.json, a 0600 file, on Linux); none stops using it.

enabled.title: jev-mod on
enabled.description: Untick to turn every feature off at once. Each feature's own mode and settings are in ~/.config/jev-mod/config.json (and a project's .claude/jev-mod.json); /jev-mod lists them and sets them.

routing.title: Routing
routing.description: Older switch, still read when ~/.config/jev-mod/config.json and the project's .claude/jev-mod.json do not set this feature. default: off unless set elsewhere. on: each turn's model and effort from the decision model's lane. off: every turn runs as Claude Code sends it.

skills.title: Skill suggestions
skills.description: Older switch, still read when ~/.config/jev-mod/config.json and the project's .claude/jev-mod.json do not set this feature. default: what jev-skills' `jev switches` set, or the mod's own default if it set nothing. shadow: ask and count, change nothing.

screening.title: Screening
screening.description: Older switch, still read when ~/.config/jev-mod/config.json and the project's .claude/jev-mod.json do not set this feature. default: what jev-skills' `jev switches` set, or the mod's own default if it set nothing. shadow: ask and count, change nothing.

private.title: Private
private.description: Send nothing to the decision backend: no routing or skill suggestions, and fetched text is screened with local patterns only.

band.title: jev-mod band
band.description: Older switch, still read when ~/.config/jev-mod/config.json and the project's .claude/jev-mod.json do not set this feature. A line above the prompt: what jev-mod decided this turn, its cost this session, what screening withheld, and the backend.
